column10: Procurement of Machinery and Trolley Mounted Pumps for mitigation of urban flooding of Guwahati city under SDRF stated as follows: 1. Procurement of Trolley Mounted Centrifugal pumps: 6 (Six) Nos. of 350 LPS & 4 (Four) Nos. of 150 LPS capacity 2. Procurement of Amphibian Excavator cum Dredger: 1 Time period for execution- 1 year
column11: 1. The pumps will aid in mitigation of urban flooding of Guwahati city. 2. The trolley mounted portable dewatering pumps is driven by diesel engine and thus make the pumps flexible to install in the water logging areas. 3. Due to shortage of portable dewatering pumps the agencies like GMC/GMDA is facing inconvenient in discharging the accumulated water from the submerged areas. 4. Amphibian Excavator cum Dredger will be engaged for periodic de-siltation and excavation of water bodies viz. Silsako Beel, Borsola Beel & Bondajan Beel for increasing the retention capacity and free flow of storm water.
